title: Index of openwashdata R Data Packages
text: Three functions return catalog tibbles. owd_packages() lists one row per package. owd_datasets() lists one row per dataset, package belongs . owd_variables() lists one row per variable, dataset belongs . owd_search("water") finds packages, datasets variables whose name description match pattern. owd_install("washmalawi") installs listed package openwashdata R-universe, CRAN fallback.

title: Search the openwashdata catalog — owd_search
text: Runs case-insensitive regular expression package, dataset variable metadata, owd_search("groundwater") answers "package data groundwater". search runs prebuilt flat index, single vectorized match regardless catalog size.

title: Search the openwashdata catalog — owd_search
Search the openwashdata catalog — owd_search
text: query single regular expression (case-insensitive). Plain words work -. fields Character vector fields search. "title", "description", "variable_name", "dataset_name", "pkg_name". default covers titles, descriptions, variable names dataset names.

title: Search the openwashdata catalog — owd_search
text: tibble hits columns pkg_name, match_type ("package", "dataset" "variable"), dataset_name, field text (matched text). Zero rows nothing matches.
